full_profile.overview_zh: OpenRig是一个Agent网络编排框架，核心创新在于将Claude Code、Codex、Pi等多个AI模型整合成持久化的Agent团队。产品解决的问题是：现有Agent工具多为单点调用，缺乏团队协作机制和工作连续性。OpenRig通过三大机制实现突破：①角色系统(roles)让不同Agent承担专门职责 ②共享上下文(shared context)确保团队记忆一致 ③工作归属(owned work)追踪每个Agent的贡献。目标用户是需要复杂AI工作流的开发者和团队。项目在GitHub Trending上单日获得200万+stars增量（数据异常但反映极高关注度），TypeScript实现，544 forks证明已有开发者fork研究。这是Claude Code生态的原生扩展，将单Agent能力升级为多Agent协同系统。
full_profile.biz_model_zh: 商业模式信息严重不足，GitHub仓库未见明确变现计划。推测可能路径：①开源+企业版订阅(类似LangChain模式) ②API调用计费(整合多模型的中间层) ③被Claude/Anthropic收购整合进官方生态。当前阶段更像开源基础设施项目，依赖社区贡献和生态位价值。风险在于：多Agent编排本身可能被Claude/OpenAI原生支持，导致中间层价值消失。但如果能建立标准化的Agent协作协议，有机会成为行业基础设施。定价逻辑尚不清晰，需要更多信息验证商业化路径。
full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角的Alpha信号：①这是Claude Code生态的关键缺失环节——官方只提供单Agent能力，OpenRig填补了多Agent协作空白，类似Kubernetes之于Docker ②市场被低估在于：大家关注单个超级Agent，但真实企业场景需要专业化分工的Agent团队(类似人类组织) ③技术路径非共识：不是做更强的单体Agent，而是做Agent间的协作协议和持久化状态管理 ④风险：200万stars增量数据异常(可能是统计bug)，实际采用率需验证；创始人背景不明，团队能力存疑；商业模式不清晰可能导致无法持续投入。投资论文适配度：符合我们关注的'AI基础设施中间层'

full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角:这是典型的'开源基础设施'项目,有价值但Alpha有限。①方向价值:私有化AI部署确实是企业刚需,尤其在数据安全敏感行业②市场低估点:可能被低估的是作为'AI操作系统'的入口价值,如果能演化成Agent编排平台会有想象空间③核心风险:同质化严重(ChatGPT UI、LobeChat等一堆开源替代),商业化路径不清晰,团队信息缺失导致执行力存疑④投资论文适配度:不符合我们'AI-native重构'的核心thesis,更像是传统软件的AI适配层。除非团队背景极强或有独特商业化路径,否则只是'有用的工具'而非'改变游戏规则的平台'。

Upload product catalogues and other docs to the Knowledge Hub, and its agent turns them into personalized messages, offers, deep searches and decks. Track client data, collaborate with your team, and manage tasks, all in one place. Connect Claude Desktop/ChatGPT Work or your code agent with kōdlo MCP to scale and orchestrate contexts.

title: Hexis Cloud
description_en: One company brain for all your AI agents. Hexis is one company brain for your team and all its AI agents. Through Hexis, your team can align on shared context that's important to align on, non-technical teams can work and collaborate on skills and your team can have hundreds of tools accessible via one MCP gateway. All the information is owned by someone, meaning it's context you can trust, and Hexis enables access control to a single file. It only takes a few minutes to set up, and is free for up to 3 people. Would love your feedback!

title: Knocket
description_en: Chat with visitors from your website or link. Makers need a way for visitors to reach them, and to reply without opening another dashboard. Paste one script tag and a chat bubble appears on any site, or publish a contact page for your bio. Visitors start typing with no account needed. Messages go to Telegram. Quote-reply and it appears on their screen, and the thread stays in your inbox. If you're away, they leave an email. An AI agent answers from your docs and hands off to you when it matters. Free, no credit card, live in minutes.

description_en: Japanese listening practice built from your own sentences. One app packed with multiple ways to listen to what you use the most. Paste what you read or journal about your day, and Tori translates each sentence, adds furigana and audio, and files it into topic islands. Then hear it four ways: passive listening with the screen off, shadowing that plays your voice next to the model, AI stories at your level, and SRS flashcards with audio on every card. When you're ready, practice speaking with an AI tutor in 15 real scenarios.

full_profile.biz_model_zh: 商业模式不明确。从产品描述推测可能采用：①免费基础发布+付费高级功能（如深度SEO审计、竞品监控）的freemium模式；②或按发布次数/功能模块收费。但无公开定价信息，无法判断用户付费意愿。竞品如Product Hunt本身免费，BetaList收费$99-299，该产品需要证明其AEO审计和AI修复卡片的独特价值才能支撑付费。目前74票的低人气表明市场验证不足，商业化路径存疑。
full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角：①方向有一定Alpha——AEO（针对ChatGPT/Perplexity等AI搜索的优化）是2024-2025年新兴需求，传统SEO工具尚未覆盖；②但执行层面问题明显：Product Hunt仅74票说明产品吸引力不足，可能是功能同质化或营销乏力；③风险：Launch平台赛道已有Product Hunt/BetaList等成熟玩家，新进入者需要10倍好的差异化，目前看不到；④该项目更像是传统营销工具加了AI标签，不符合我们对AI-native深度重构的投资论文。除非团队有特殊背景或已有付费数据证明PMF，否则不建议跟进。
full_profile.score_narrative_zh: AI Native得12分：产品提到AI fix cards（AI生成修复建议），但这更像是传统SEO工具的AI功能增强，而非AI-native重构。核心流程仍是人工提交产品→平台展示→获取反向链接，AI仅在审计环节辅助，未形成数据飞轮或自进化能力。Niche得14分：AEO（Answer Engine Optimization）是较新的细分方向，有一定前瞻性，但Launch平台本身是红海市场，差异化不明显。商业模式得11分：无公开定价和付费用户数据，商业逻辑不清晰，74票的低人气暗示市场验证不足。团队得6分：创始人仅显示nhrdev（可能是开发者昵称），无背景信息，无法判断AI能力和行业经验。加分12分：涉及AEO这一新兴方向+3，有Product Hunt发布证明产品已上线+2，SEO+竞品监控是刚需场景+2，Launch Battle机制有社区运营潜力+2，有永久页面和dofollo

title: DevTerminal
description_en: A macOS terminal with a Run button that knows your project. DevTerminal is a normal macOS terminal (your shell, your config) where every tab knows what project it's in. ⌘R in an Android app installs it on your phone and streams logcat. In an iOS app it launches in the Simulator or on your iPhone. Spring Boot, Next.js, Flutter, React Native, Rust, Go, Django, Rails and more just work. Run output sits under your shell, so Claude Code keeps the tab. $39 once, no subscription.

title: Faithfulness Without Anchors: A Position Paper on the Structural Misalignments of Explainable AI Faithfulness Metrics for Feature Importance
description_en: arXiv:2610.12493v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) tools have often been presented as methods to increase trust in machine learning models by making aspects of their algorithms more human-understandable. However, evidence accumulated over the last decade points to an overall failure of this objective, instead promoting overreliance on incorrect predictions, which can subsequently lead to algorithmic aversion. Rather, XAI appears to function primarily as a debugging tool, useful for obtaining anecdotal insights into, for example, features learned by the model. One of the main issues underlying this limitation is that XAI methods often oversimplify the inner workings of the model, resulting in misalignment between the explanation and the model itself -
description_zh: 这是一篇发表在arXiv的学术论文，主要批判当前可解释AI(XAI)工具的根本性问题。论文指出XAI工具原本承诺通过让算法更易理解来增加对机器学习模型的信任，但过去十年的证据表明这一目标基本失败，反而导致用户过度依赖错误预测，最终引发算法厌恶。作者认为XAI实际上主要作为调试工具使用，只能提供关于模型学习特征的零散洞察。核心问题在于XAI方法过度简化了模型内部运作机制，导致解释与模型本身之间存在结构性错位(structural misalignment)。论文聚焦于特征重要性的忠实度指标(faithfulness metrics)的缺陷分析。这是纯学术研究，无产品形态、无用户、无商业模式，仅为理论贡献。

full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角：这个项目代表了一个反向信号——它暴露了AI编程工具市场的定价痛点，说明有大量开发者认为现有工具太贵。但从投资角度看，这是典型的'无护城河套壳'项目。它没有创造新价值，只是重新分配现有资源。真正的Alpha在于：①理解为什么开发者需要这种'破解'工具（定价策略问题）②谁能提供合法的低成本替代方案（如开源模型+优化推理）③这个需求规模有多大。风险极高：法律风险、可持续性风险、无变现路径。我们应该关注的是解决同样痛点但有合法商业模式的项目，比如开源模型优化、本地部署方案或差异化定价的AI IDE。

title: Dropstone CLI
